verdict.rationale: A hands-on dry run shows `ultrametric init` writing a SKILL.md skill folder to both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills), and the docs say these skill files can be committed and shared. That points to a portable SKILL.md-based skill layout usable across more than one harness. However, nothing in the evidence says the skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification, and the pack shows no SKILL.md contents or frontmatter. missing for 10: an explicit claim of Agent Skills spec conformance, evidence of SKILL.md structure/frontmatter, validation against the spec, and independent corroboration of portability beyond the two targeted harnesses.
